items.summary: Opus proposed a change to what goes into the brief (retirement): also include tax and rule facts, and market-shock facts; use up to 10 facts (was 6).
items.summary_technical: Proposed a change to policy:retirement v1 (prop-5aaf6716): include_kinds: + regulation, + disruption; max_facts: 6 -> 10.

payload.rationale: The missed answers are rule changes (RMD age, Medicare Part B premium, estate tax exemption) and the market sell-off, which fit the excluded 'regulation' and 'disruption' kinds. The fact cap goes up so these do not push out account facts such as the updated retirement timing.

payload.decision: Rejected: held-out accuracy 0.74 -> 0.92, but false alarms rose 0.17 -> 0.25 per run; context grew 240 -> 365 tokens (+52%, over the +50% allowed).

items.summary: Opus proposed a change to what goes into the brief (retirement): also include tax and rule facts, and market-shock facts; put the facts that affect this client first.
items.summary_technical: Proposed a change to policy:retirement v1 (prop-a1790af0): include_kinds: + regulation, + disruption; prefer_exposed: False -> True.

payload.rationale: Advisors lacked the sell-off and the new RMD age, which are disruption and regulation facts that the policy never lets in. Keeping max_facts at 6 and preferring facts the household is exposed to should keep context size flat and push out generic items like Treasury yields and fund news, which are the likely source of the earlier false alarms.

items.summary: Opus proposed a change to what goes into the brief (retirement): use up to 8 facts (was 6).
items.summary_technical: Proposed a change to policy:retirement v2 (prop-92fe0734): max_facts: 6 -> 8.

payload.rationale: The missed tuning questions ask about figures that are not in the brief at all: months to retirement (12), the Medicare Part B premium (187) and the estate tax exemption (7.15). This suggests the 6-fact cap drops them once the sell-off, yields, RMD, CD and annuity facts fill it. The earlier 6 -> 10 step was rejected for context growth, so this is a smaller +2 on max_facts alone, with no change to include_kinds.
